dialog.speaker: neighbor
dialog.tr: Eline sağlık. Bizim kapının önünü de alıver, kürek elindeyken.
dialog.en: Lovely work. Do our doorway too, while you've got the shovel.

dialog.speaker: neighbor
dialog.tr: Arabanın üstünü de. Ben camdan tarif ederim.
dialog.en: And the top of the car. I'll direct from the window.

choices.en: Clear the entrance, park the shovel
Leave a note on it, go upstairs

hepsi.tr: Girişi, komşunun kapısını ve iki arabayı temizledin; kırk dakika sürdü. Akşam kapına bir tencere çorba geldi.
hepsi.en: You cleared the entrance, the neighbor's doorway, and two cars. It took forty minutes. That evening a pot of soup arrived at your door.

coach.tr: Kırk dakika kürek. Ücret tencereyle ödendi.
coach.en: Forty minutes of shoveling. Payment was made by the pot.

giris.tr: Girişi açıp küreği duvara dayadın. Öğlene kadar üç komşu küreği sırayla kullandı; biri sapını bantladı.
giris.en: You cleared the entrance and leaned the shovel on the wall. By noon three neighbors had used it in turn. One of them taped the handle.

coach.tr: Kürek öğlene kadar üç el değiştirdi.
coach.en: By noon the shovel had passed through three sets of hands.

not.tr: Küreği "isteyen kullansın" notuyla kapıya bıraktın. Akşam kürek yerindeydi; not da, kar da.
not.en: You left the shovel by the door with a note: help yourself. That evening the shovel was still there. So was the note. So was the snow.

coach.en: The note was read. The shovel was not lifted.

intent.setup: kar yağdığı sabah apartman girişini kürerken komşunun pencereden yeni işler eklemesi
